rec.name: Optimized Price Communication (Global Price Display Simplification)
rec.status: Built — implemented; compare-at toggle rolled out store-wide (Sept 2025)

what.text: A global, store-wide simplification of how prices are shown. In the screenshot, the product card changes from 'price + per-liter base price' (21,90 € · 43,80 € / l) to a cleaner card showing only the current price (21,90 €), with the image, title, star rating and review count kept. A theme setting also lets the team switch compare-at (strike-through) prices on or off everywhere in the store. Note: the screenshot shows the base/unit price being removed, while the comments only mention the compare-at price. The ticket does not clarify whether the unit price is covered by the same setting.

why.text: Fewer price figures mean lower cognitive load and a clearer anchor on the one number that matters. A per-liter base price or a strike-through price can invite comparison and doubt, or make a discount feel less credible. A single clean price keeps attention on the product, rating and add-to-cart. Being able to switch the compare-at price on or off globally also makes it easy to A/B test whether discount anchoring helps or hurts this brand.

how.text: Add a checkbox in the theme settings (e.g. 'Show compare-at price'). Wrap every compare-at price output in the theme (product cards, PDP, cart, search, etc.) in a Liquid conditional on that setting, rather than deleting the markup from the theme files. When the setting is off, the compare-at price appears nowhere in the store. For the unit price, apply the same pattern: hide the base price in the card price snippet (the ticket does not confirm that this is behind a setting). Result: only the current price is shown under the title and rating.

items: Theme setting: show / hide compare-at (strike-through) price globally (enable/disable)
Possibly a matching show/hide for the per-liter unit price on cards (inferred from the screenshot, not confirmed in the ticket)

dependencies.text: Needs a Shopify theme with access to the theme settings schema (settings_schema.json) and edits to the price snippets used across templates. No app is mentioned. Compare-at prices and unit prices come from standard Shopify product/variant data. A Loom preview exists but its contents were not available to review.

items: Add-to-cart rate from collection and product cards

images.caption: Before → after product card: the price line changes from '21,90 € 43,80 € / l' to just '21,90 €', with the rest of the card unchanged.
